text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. A balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and water gives you energy and helps you stay well. Regular exercise, such as walking or cycling, keeps your body strong and reduces stress. Getting enough sleep is also important, because it helps your brain and body recover. Don't forget your mental health: talk to friends and family when you feel worried, and make time to relax. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance by separating work from your free time. Small daily habits can make a big difference to how you feel.
